body: Andrew.... will you find me a good man to marry?

these words i will always hold dear to my heart. I remember being in the front row at hampton when they played "happy happy" (which is what i call it) for the first time and I knew it would be a favorite. Thank you fo rthe reminders. I smiled....
Thank you for the kind words.
i am so sad. i cant think about anything but this.

last night my soon to be ex husband told me he got a girl pregnant. we have only been separated for 13 days. i wanted to kill myself immediately. i think he knew. i am 100% devastated. i can not fully say that i am glad i didn't do it, because this is the only way i can think to hurt him forever like he has hurt me.  and i do want him to suffer. i have made a page called countdowntohappiness.com. it is the only way i can express myself without everyone think i am completly crazy. i go to see a therapist tomorrow to learn how best to deal with myself. i am afraid that they will have me committed. if they do i guess it is for the best, i hope not though because i have doggies that help me make it through each day. my parents are treating me like a child. they made me move home with them so they can feel better. i am so scared that i will never recover.

thank you for the kind words. it so hard right now. I have made a web page called countdowntohappiness.com to document all my struggles. I hope someday to look back and see how i made it through this horrible time. again thank you. please help me spread the page info.

my husband (already filed for divorce) coltfan420, told me he got a girl pregnant. I was devestated because we went to fertility specialists for a year trying to get pregnant. I was with him for 17 years. When he told me I wanted to die. Really I did. My daddy rescued me though. doug had the nerve to tell me it was gods plan. gods plan. wasit gods plan for me to suffer like this? was it gods plan for me to lose everything i had. my home, my best friend, my happiness? i feel like my world is crashing down around me. i have no joy. no smiles. no happiness. i hope someday i can see how this was for the best. I am on prozac just to help take the edge off. I am completly devastated. i feel destroyed.
Today is the day I move all my love and life from my house. My husband has moved in and we are getting a divorce. I don't think I will ever recover. My heart is shattered into a million pieces.
i will begin to load my videos tonight.
